determinism.serialization: UTF-8 canonical JSON uses NFC strings, sorted mapping keys, compact separators, ASCII escapes, bounded integers, no floats, and exactly one trailing newline

effects.filesystem: none during descriptor construction, validation, compatibility negotiation, capability routing, cost estimation, replay-basis calculation, serialization, or identity calculation; runtime filesystem access must be declared and isolated
effects.mutation: constructed descriptor, fragment, routing, and cost values are immutable and caller-owned mutable objects are never retained by alias
effects.network: none during descriptor operations; runtime network access must be declared by policy and executed only through the later worker boundary

effects.solver: none during descriptor validation, routing, or plan_cost; solve and check effects are governed by their exact declarations and child budgets

ensures: TheoryPlugin contains one stable plugin ID and version, exact API and implementation provenance, separate producer and checker identities, complete compatibility bindings, canonical capabilities, a fixed four-operation ABI, lifecycle and effect policies, replay identity, hard limits, and namespaced non-semantic extensions.

Capability routing compares exact theory, domain, quantifier, expression, relation, polynomial-degree, quantifier-depth, variable-count, ambiguity, arithmetic, and theory-feature boundaries; any overclaim or unmatched dimension returns unsupported.

Planning cost is the bounded exact-integer sum of base, per-variable, per-expression-node, per-quantifier-count, per-goal, and ambiguity terms, saturates at the declared maximum, has no effects or authority, and ties break by lowest cost, highest priority, then capability ID.

The fixed operation order is plan_cost, solve, check, explain; every operation binds exact request and response contract sets, component identity, response schema, child-budget policy, cancellation semantics, replay modes, declared effects, authority, and outcome set.
plan_cost is deterministic, unbudgeted, uncancellable, effect-free, and authority-free; it can only report completed, unsupported, or error.

solve uses the producer component, a ResourceBudget child lease, cooperative cancellation, explicit replay, and only producer-report authority; it returns EngineResult and Evidence bindings and cannot emit checker attestation.

check uses the distinct checker component, independently bound Evidence, a ResourceBudget child lease, cooperative cancellation, explicit replay, and Certificate checker-attestation authority; it cannot reuse producer identity.
explain uses no mathematical authority and cannot promote text, formatting, retained artifacts, or successful execution into proof, refutation, or verification.

Unsupported, ambiguous, inconclusive, invalid, cancelled, exhausted, truncated, verifier-failed, disagreement, and error outcomes remain explicit and cannot be represented as ordinary completion or verified success.

Canonical descriptor serialization and SHA-256 identity are reproducible without importing the entry point, initializing the plugin, invoking a solver or checker, reading the environment, or performing declared effects.

epistemics.checker_attestation: check may emit Certificate authority only under the distinct checker identity and all Evidence, replay, trust, artifact, and budget rules of accepted dependent contracts
epistemics.explanation: explain produces user-facing structure with no mathematical authority and cannot alter bound verdicts or trust dependencies
epistemics.invalid: one or more descriptor or routing invariants fail and no plugin registration, routing, cost, operation, replay, or authority decision is returned
epistemics.mathematical_truth: never inferred from descriptor validity, capability support, low estimated cost, lifecycle readiness, operation completion, plugin priority, or producer output
epistemics.producer_report: solve may report EngineResult and Evidence under exact producer provenance but cannot independently establish proof, refutation, exactness, or certificate validity
epistemics.supported: one declared capability exactly contains the fragment and wins deterministic cost, priority, and ID ordering; this authorizes routing only, not mathematical truth
epistemics.unsupported: no declared capability contains every fragment dimension or a required version, contract, format, feature, platform, extension, or effect is unavailable
epistemics.valid: all descriptor, canonicalization, identity, compatibility, provenance, capability, cost, operation, effect, lifecycle, replay, and budget invariants pass without importing or trusting plugin code

API semantic major is exactly 1, semantic major and minor equal numeric compatibility fields, minimum reader minor does not exceed writer minor, api.contract_sha256 equals this accepted contract, and package and component versions equal plugin_version.

Root implementation hash and configuration equal producer identities, replay configuration equals root configuration, producer role is producer, checker role is checker, and producer/checker component IDs and implementation authority remain distinct.

The foundational compatibility contract registry contains exactly six accepted ID, SHA-256, and schema triples in stable order; Python versions, platforms, extensions, and plugin dependencies sort and deduplicate.
Required and optional extensions do not overlap; a plugin cannot depend on itself; every dependency has a nonempty semantic-version interval and exact descriptor content hash.

Capabilities sort by ID; theories and every fragment set sort and deduplicate; required and forbidden features do not overlap; decision and construction capabilities declare Evidence formats; verification capabilities declare Certificate formats; every format minor interval is nonempty.

Capability fragment summaries bind theories, domains, quantifiers, expression kinds, relation kinds, polynomial degree, quantifier count and depth, variables, expression nodes, goals, ambiguity, exact arithmetic, and theory features before routing or cost calculation.

Cost coefficients, counts, products, and sums are exact nonnegative integers in the portable range; maximum is at least base; confidence is positive and at most one million parts per million; overflow fails instead of wrapping or becoming cheap.

Operations occur in the fixed ABI order and exactly bind the normative components, contracts, response schemas, child leases, cancellation rules, replay modes, effects, authorities, and outcomes; solve cannot attest, check cannot produce, and explain cannot authorize.

The effect registry contains environment, filesystem, network, process, and solver entries in order; none has no policy or reason, declared has both, operation effects are subsets, plan_cost uses none, and any external effect requires subprocess isolation.

A non-reentrant or non-thread-safe plugin has maximum concurrency one; invocation-scoped state cannot persist; subprocess isolation has a positive shutdown timeout; seeded initialization requires seeded replay support.
Replay modes sort and deduplicate; seed policy is forbidden without seeded mode and explicit-required with it; descriptor_basis_sha256 covers every descriptor field while excluding only itself.

Cancelled, exhausted, and truncated operation outcomes remain terminal ResourceBudget states; cooperative cancellation is required for every budgeted operation and no partial output gains completion or authority.

Canonical input contains at most 67108864 bytes, 4000000 visited values, 64 nesting levels, 100000 descriptor entities and items per array, and 1048576 code points per string; validation is bounded by 30 seconds and 512 MiB.

Component and capability IDs share one collision-free descriptor namespace; extensions cannot override API, implementation, capability, fragment, cost, operation, authority, effect, lifecycle, replay, compatibility, budget, or identity semantics.
